roughness_recalibration.note: the derived orographic term carries no solved coefficient, so a difference between two rungs is terrain and aggregation alone. The land means here are this arm's AGGREGATE-THEN-PROCESS side -- the cover roughness is a linear mean of lengths, which is the reduction the gap exists to measure against -- so they are not the field's own land mean, which build_surface_roughness.py reduces in ce at the blending height and reports per rung. `namelist_fallback_m` is the model's uniform default over land and is neither a target nor an anchor.
